High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is an application under Section 430 (1) & (2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short, "BNSS") by the appellant-petitioner-Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak for grant of bail pending suspension of further execution of sentence till disposal of the appeal.
3. Heard, Mr. Bibhu Prasad Das, learned counsel for the appellant-petitioner-Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak and Mr. S.K. Rout, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.

4. It appears from the record that the appellant- petitioner-Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak has been convicted for offences punishable U/Ss.363/366/376 of IPC and the maximum substantive sentence as awarded to the appellant-petitioner is for seven years.
This Court, however, has the privilege to go through the evidence of the victim and the doctor examining the victim.

5. In view of the above facts and after taking into consideration the custody period of the appellant- petitioner-Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak and on going through the evidence of the victim and the appeal being unlikely to be heard in near future, this Court admits the appellant-petitioner-Kalia @
Rashmiranjan Nayak to bail pending suspension of further execution of the sentence till disposal of the appeal and directs for suspension of his sentence.
Unknown vs State Of Odisha on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62423054/
1 6.
Accordingly the appellant-petitioner-Kalia @ Rashmiranjan Nayak be released on bail on such terms and conditions as deems fit and proper by the convicting Court.
7. The I.A. is accordingly disposed of.
CRLA No. 1300 of 2024 & CRLA No.72 of 2025 8.

Since both these appeals have been admitted and LCR has already been received, Office is requested to prepare paper books and supply the same to the learned counsel for the parties in accordance with Rules.

9. List these matters on 12th May, 2025.
(G. Satapathy) Judge S. Sasmal
